newsitem.title: USA: Angelica sees Q3 restructuring charge.
newsitem.headline: Angelica sees Q3 restructuring charge.

text.p: Angelica Corp, whose 1997 second quarter profits fell by more than half, said Friday it would take a charge against third quarter earnings to cover some restructuring actions taken to improve the company's financial performance.

Angelica said it will take a 1997 third quarter pre-tax charge of about $18 million to $20 million to cover costs of eliminating certain underperforming or unneeded facilities. The charge will also cover costs of severance payments and a reduction in excess and obsolete inventory.
Trading in Angelica shares was halted pending an announcement.
"We intend to return Angelica to a satisfactory level of financial performance," said Leslie Lowe, recently elected chairman and interim president and chief executive officer.
Angelica makes and markets uniforms, operates retail uniform and shoe stores, and provides textile rental and laundry services to health care institutions.

The company reported 1997 second quarter earnings fell 51.4 percent to $1.3 million or $0.14 a share from $2.7 million or $0.30 in the same period a year ago. Sales and revenues rose 5.4 percent over the 1996 second quarter to $129.2 million.

Second quarter sales of its manufacturing and marketing business fell 4.1 percent from last year. Better sales and earnings in its Canadian and British operations were more than offset by a modest sales decline and a substantial loss incurred by Angelica Image Apparel in the U.S.

A strike at two manufacturing plants is over, but one plant is permanently closed while the other is back in production, the company said. The impact of these costs and some lost sales affected second quarter results, it said.
Lawrence Young, former chairman, president and chief executive, will become president of the manufacturing and marketing segment.
"We are confident that concentrating his efforts on this segment will lead to better performance in the future," Lowe said in a statement.
